criteria.task: Draw visibility edges for CPU descriptor/payload writes, device fetch, device result writes and CPU observation. Assign compiler barrier, architectural ordering and any cache maintenance only to edges they actually satisfy.

criteria.task: Cancel generation7, keep its buffer unavailable until quiescence, then reuse for 8 and deliver a delayed callback7. Reject it before modifying current state and prove no old DMA actor can still write after reuse.

criteria.task: For a shared DMA buffer classify four proposed fixes: compiler memory clobber, DMB/DSB, cache clean/invalidate and interrupt masking. Give a failing trace for each when used in place of another required mechanism.

criteria.task: Audit the F439 SRAM/DMA path and refuse fictitious core-data-cache flush calls. Explain the actual barrier purpose and separately identify Flash acceleration as a different subsystem; consult complete instruction definitions before prescribing sequences.

criteria.task: Compare cacheless F439 SRAM, a synthetic write-back noncoherent cache and the retained H745 shared-memory contract. Track CPU dirty lines, device visibility and ownership at each transition.
